answer: Random task lottery stops alias farming. The system assigns each alias at most 2 jobs per epoch from one mixed pool, so one operator cannot steer 50 copies toward easy high pay work. A sonnet edit and a ledge survey sit in the same draw as an ember stock count, and aliases cannot swap assignments. A weekly audit re-checks one assigned job per alias. An alias caught trading assignments or filing work done by another alias loses assignment rights for 15 epochs and forfeits that epoch pay.
